observations.observation: Before the vote, the proxy scheduled Iridium’s virtual special meeting for 8:30 a.m. ET on Sep. 24, 2026, and stated that stockholder adoption of the merger agreement was required for completion.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: This was a scheduled meeting and an unmet condition in the pre-event proxy; it does not establish the vote outcome.

observations.observation: The joint company release reports that Iridium stockholders adopted the merger agreement at the special meeting on Sep. 24; approximately 99.6% of votes cast favored it, representing approximately 81.0% of shares entitled to vote.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The release gives approximate percentages and says complete voting results would be reported in an 8-K; the announcement does not timestamp when during the meeting the result was reached.

observations.observation: The same Sep. 24 release says the transaction is expected to close by mid-2027, subject to remaining required regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions; the shareholder vote was not described as closing the transaction.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: This is the companies’ stated expectation, not confirmation that the remaining approvals or other closing conditions will be satisfied.

observations.observation: A pre-cutoff Rocket Lab update said the HSR waiting period expired Aug. 12 and that FCC applications seeking consent to transfer Iridium licenses and authorizations had been filed Aug. 10.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The FCC filing records an application, not a decision. The Sep. 24 release continued to make closing subject to remaining required regulatory approvals.

gaps: No independent contemporaneous report with a publication time demonstrably before cutoff was verified. A Sep. 24 Light Reading item surfaced, but it is dated only to the day, labels itself “#pressrelease,” and substantially republishes the company release, so its pre-cutoff availability and independent corroboration are not established.
The exact time the stockholder vote was completed is not stated in the release; the event is therefore recorded at date precision, separately from the 16:30 ET publication time.
An SEC 8-K search result contains detailed vote counts, but its acceptance time was not verified as before cutoff; it is not used for those details.
research_notes: Cutoff: 2026-09-24T20:35:07.133243Z. The earliest time-stamped public item located is the companies’ joint release, distributed by PR Newswire at 16:30 ET (20:30Z), about five minutes before cutoff. The pre-meeting proxy had scheduled the vote for 8:30 a.m. ET on September 24 and identified stockholder adoption as a completion condition. The release reports adoption, but also says closing remains expected by mid-2027 subject to required regulatory approvals and customary conditions. No post-cutoff coverage or market reaction is used.
